name.title: Inverter Display Name
name.description: The name that will be displayed in your Apple Home App and Homebridge logs

serialPort.title: Serial Port Path (For USB/RS485 Connection)
serialPort.description: Leave unchanged if using a USB cable directly plugged into your Raspberry Pi.

ipAddress.title: Inverter IP Address (For Wi-Fi/LAN Connection)
ipAddress.description: ONLY fill this out if your inverter connects over your local network. Leave blank if using a USB cable.

uploadInterval.title: Data Upload Interval (seconds)
uploadInterval.description: How often to aggregate and upload averaged data to SolarCharge API (60-3600 seconds, default 300 = 5 minutes)

plantId.title: Plant ID
plantId.description: Enter your SolarCharge Plant ID for uploading inverter data

serialNum.title: Serial Number
serialNum.description: Enter your SolarCharge serial number for uploading data

inverterProfile.title: Inverter Profile (Manufacturer Detection)
inverterProfile.description: Set to 'auto' to detect your inverter automatically during startup. Or manually select your brand/model to skip detection.

logLevel.title: Log Level
logLevel.description: Control verbosity of plugin logs. Use 'debug' to troubleshoot auto-detection issues.
